children: Sterling looks unlikely to strengthen further as market expectations of the Bank of England rate increases over the coming months look overdone, Monex forex analysts say in a note. The latest U.K. inflation data showed annual headline inflation rose to 3.6% in October, from 3.5% in September, in line with the consensus forecast by economists in a WSJ poll. Monex still expects the BOE to raise rates at the Dec. 17 policy meeting. However, they view market pricing of three BOE rate rises by mid-2027, in addition to the rate increase delivered in November as excessive, the analysts say. Sterling falls 0.3% versus the dollar to $1.3165, and the euro rises 0.1% against sterling to 0.8332 pounds. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
